title.narrative: Climate Change- and Disaster-Resilient Water Resources Sector Project - Additional Financing

description.narrative: The proposed additional financing will expand the project's scope by (i) modernizing irrigation infrastructure, (ii) integrating automation systems, (iii) adopting advanced water management technologies, (iv) introducing nature-based solutions and watershed management planning, (v) enhancing early warning systems and precipitation monitoring, and (vi) strengthening institutional capacity for sustainable operations.

title.narrative: Reports and Recommendations of the President

description.narrative: Climate change and disaster resilience of infrastructure, and water security improved

Annual number of households and area of agricultural land protected and rehabilitated from disaster impacts by the Northern and Southern ERC works increased to 66,000 households and 46,000 ha (2015-2017 annual average baselines: 20,700 households and 10,700 ha) DR7 Data Source: MES annual reports Baseline value: 20,700 and 10,700 ha

Average gross margin of agricultural production increased to $2,165 per ha across target areas of at least 45,000 ha in areas affected by climate hazards (2017 baseline: about $1,900 per ha) DR9 Data Source: Annual WUA reports. Baseline value: $1,900 per ha

Average productivity of water withdrawn increased to 0.85 kg/m3 for wheat, 0.95 kg/m3 for corn, and 2.4 kg/m3 for strawberries across target areas of at least 45,000 ha through climate-adaptive irrigation water infrastructure and agriculture (2017 baselines: 0.60 kg/m3 for wheat and 0.60 kg/m3 for corn; 2025 baseline: 1.7 kg/m3 for strawberries) DR9 Data Source: Annual WUA reports. Baseline value: .6 kg/m3; .6 kg/m3
